title: Eisenhower's meeting with ETs about stopping nuclear proliferation

tellings.quote: happened? Well, I got a I got a series of reports from the French Ministry of Defense indicating that meeting did happen, but it wasn't the mythology you're referring to.

related.note: Same alleged Eisenhower meeting with ETs in 1954, but Greer says French documents show it was about stopping nuclear proliferation, not a treaty allowing grey abductions.

plain: President Dwight D. Eisenhower did meet with beings from another world in the mid-1950s, near Palm Springs, California, and the talk was about stopping the spread of nuclear weapons. That is the claim of Steven Greer, a UFO researcher, who says a series of reports from the French Ministry of Defense shows the meeting took place, though "it wasn't the mythology" people usually tell. If true, a US president would have been dealing directly with visitors over the bomb.
